businessAndServiceBoundary.businessMeaning: Publish one canonical People-owned employment invalidation and expose one minimized, exact-relationship owner recovery snapshot so Time can evaluate absence eligibility without owning or directly reading People employment data.
businessAndServiceBoundary.effectiveDateBoundary: CURRENT_BUSINESS_DATE_ONLY; past or future effectiveOn fails closed until an effective-dated worker-status owner exists

xcon004Publication: Preserve the closed four-field XCON-004 body unchanged.
Register type dwp.hris.people.employment-changed.v1 at major 1 and source urn:dwp:people:hris:employment.
Use WORK_RELATIONSHIP aggregate identity, relationshipPublicId aggregate id and positive newAggregateVersion ordering.
Capture one application Instant, truncate to microseconds and use it for both canonical envelope time and legacy occurred_at.
Record the validated canonical DomainEventEnvelope in the same employment publication transaction while retaining the legacy row as compatibility evidence and without setting legacy published_at.
Reuse the existing deterministic event-id algorithm byte-for-byte; no polling bridge or direct broker I/O.
xcon027Contract: Append XCON-027 and its nested assignment contract to the canonical schema, codegen manifest, generated immutable Java artifact and focused contract tests.
Append XCON-027 and SVC-PEP-HRM-007 rows to the two exact canonical frontend registers without rewriting historical rows.
Keep relationshipRevision, minimumRelationshipRevision and assignmentRevision nonnegative; keep event aggregate sequence positive.
Use closed shapes, canonical ordering, minimized current-business-date facts, strict digest fields and no sensitive placeholders.
Append the canonical event/query declarations only; do not mutate XCON-001 through XCON-026 or SVC-PEP-HRM-002 semantics.
svcPepHrm007: Implement the exact relationship-only TIME_ABSENCE_V1 GET contract and typed data-plus-evidence or signed problem response.

Fail closed before fact reads on wrong workload, mTLS/JWT binding, issuer, audience, client, subject, tenant, method, path, query, correlation, purpose, projection, grant revision, business zone/date, digest, signature or expiry.
Reuse sys_domain_event_inbox for the atomic jti-plus-nonce reservation; add no private replay table and no migration.

Keep publication and query switches default OFF with zero enrolled tenants.

migration.rule: Reuse existing People stores only; no historical or new migration may be authored in this HRM phase. TIME_MAIN V14 is reserved only by a later HRIS-TIM packet after HRM admission.

acceptanceCriteria: TIM003-AC01 XCON-004 remains the four-field closed EmploymentChanged.v1 business contract and no sensitive or Time-owned fact is added.
TIM003-AC02 The transport type is dwp.hris.people.employment-changed.v1 with source urn:dwp:people:hris:employment, WORK_RELATIONSHIP aggregate identity and relationship revision ordering.

TIM003-AC03 Envelope subject, aggregate id and sequence exactly equal WORK_RELATIONSHIP/{relationshipPublicId}, relationshipPublicId and newAggregateVersion; mismatch, unknown type or unsupported major fails closed to the shared DLQ.

TIM003-AC04 HRIS-HRM registers the canonical event major, captures one publication Instant, and writes both canonical envelope and legacy compatibility evidence in one transaction without changing legacy published_at, direct broker I/O or treating legacy aggregate metadata as canonical.

TIM003-AC05 XCON-027 provides exact typed, minimized current-business-date relationship and nested assignment revisions for recovery, and new SVC-PEP-HRM-007 exposes it only through workload-authenticated TIME_ABSENCE_V1 exact relationship recovery while SVC-PEP-HRM-002 remains unchanged; historical or future dates fail closed until an effective-dated worker-status owner exists.

TIM003-AC06 Wrong workload, tenant, issuer, audience, client, subject, mTLS confirmation, method, path, query, token time, replay id, correlation, purpose, projection, field set, business zone/date, scope/content/evidence digest, signature, revision or expiry returns no usable owner facts and produces owner audit evidence.
TIM003-AC07 HRIS-TIM reuses the shared inbox, offset, retry, replay and DLQ ledger and creates no competing delivery ledger.

TIM003-AC08 Same-id same-digest delivery is idempotent, same-id different-digest delivery is quarantined, older shared-offset revision is a no-op, a covered contiguous revision uses the no-refetch fast path, and any unresolved or gap inbox row blocks current reads until reconciled and trusted recovery succeeds.
TIM003-AC09 V14 creates exactly one tenant-isolated abs_employment_relationship_projections table with forced RLS, closed states, deterministic assignment facts and projection-version CAS.

TIM003-AC10 Owner recovery never regresses a relationship revision and atomically binds projection CAS replacement, required exact offset CAS, GAP-mode DEFERRED-only settlement or eventless OWNER_BASELINE zero-row settlement, replay audit and structured audit evidence; REPLAY_PENDING, DEAD and payload conflicts are never snapshot-settled, and snapshot-only recovery stores no fabricated last event id.

TIM003-AC11 Non-CURRENT, expired, inbox-blocked or non-current-date projections fail closed for absence evaluation; an eligible eventless projection miss schedules a fenced trusted owner baseline, a retry-safe reconciler repairs gap/quarantine state after crashes, and no direct People database access, leave request mutation, balance mutation or approval behavior is introduced.

TIM003-AC12 Producer, query and consumer remain default OFF with zero enrolled tenants, no route or menu, no production broker and zero business-completion credit until later admission and activation authority.

startPreconditions: This packet is committed and pushed on frontend dwp-dev and its exact authority-carrier commit is pinned.
Fresh backend and frontend worktrees are materialized at the exact planned paths from the pinned repositories with clean porcelain and no unexpected upstream.
One worktree-materialization receipt records both worktrees and proves the backend base pin remains exact.
One executable start token hash-binds this packet and the receipt; no migration lease is required.
deferredAndForbiddenClaims: A current control-plane-backed TIM003OwnerGrantV1 projection or issuer exists.
Any tenant is enrolled or either feature switch is enabled.
A production broker binding, route, menu or UI is admitted.
HRIS-TIM source, dwp-core source or TIME_MAIN V14 is authorized by this packet.
Leave, return or termination command production exists.
BASE-TFR-TIM-003, Batch-04, R7 or HRIS is complete.
invalidationConditions: Any base pin or origin exactness differs before worktree materialization.
XCON-004 gains fields or changes its existing four-field semantics.
SVC-PEP-HRM-002, XCON-001 through XCON-026 or a historical migration is changed beyond the exact XCON-004 transport registration authorized here.
A People or Time migration, dwp-core change, direct People database access from Time, browser route, menu, tenant enrollment or production broker is required.
Historical or future effectiveOn is served from current-only worker status.
Current authority is derived from the request JWT, stored Time projection, startup-only configuration or the other service response.
Any writable path outside the exact boundary is required.
